note: Multiple sources indicate the conjecture originated in the mid-to-late 1970s. Wikipedia's article on Abstract Elementary Classes states it dates to 1976, while Shelah's foundational work 'Classification theory and the number of non-isomorphic models' was published in 1978. The conjecture appears as an open problem in Shelah's work from this period. A version for classes axiomatized in L_ω₁,ω appears as an open problem in Shelah's 1978 work, indicating the conjecture or related ideas date to at least 1978.
